scope: All five original-size finished-native frames viewed per listed subject. Pending triage and Claude admission.

rows.name: Snipe
rows.observation: Continuous body, bill, wing, tail and leg silhouettes in all five frames. No visible neck ribbon, detached feather or background slit. Golden hit discs and blue-white dodge sweep are transient FX. Bowed right-side late idle retained.

rows.name: Ostrich
rows.observation: Right creature has a detached small head/beak fragment above the bowed head and a floating white tail-plume fragment in turn3 reaction and both late idle frames. No transient FX at these positions; HOLD ownership-island class.
rows.next: Existing bounded remainder-island repair on this newly admitted fit; no ruler or source-pixel change.

rows.name: Pheasant
rows.observation: Right creature has a detached red facial patch above the head, white collar fragment behind neck and a separate raised tail-feather piece in turn3 reaction and both idle frames. HOLD ownership-island class.
rows.next: Existing bounded remainder-island repair on this newly admitted fit; no ruler or source-pixel change.

rows.name: Tern
rows.observation: Right creature shows a detached black crown/upper-neck wedge behind head and an open neck-to-wing seam in turn3 reaction and idle frames. HOLD ownership-island class; apply existing bounded repair to this new fit.

rows.name: Cockatoo
rows.observation: Turn3 reaction opens a tall triangular background slit through right head/crest-to-neck junction, separating rear yellow crest feathers from the head. Confirmed at 3x diagnostic crop. Idle closes; reaction remains HOLD despite bounded repair.

rows.name: Frigatebird
rows.observation: Right creature develops a pointed raised black neck/back strip in turn3 reaction and late idle; source upper contour is smooth in turn1. Hold for observed source-join class.

rows.name: Hoatzin
rows.observation: Head crest stays rooted and no detached head fragment or open neck gap visible across five frames. Layered pale tail shafts remain continuous; natural bow retained.
rows.followupObservation: Enlarged original-size frame crop reveals an open background band through the lower folded-wing/body junction. Earlier tail-shaft interpretation is superseded; hold for body/wing ownership repair or round2 repaint.

rows.name: Kakapo
rows.observation: Turn3 reaction opens a wide triangular background slit between right head and shoulder, with a raised back point. Both idle frames close. Hold despite mechanical PASS.

rows.name: Kookaburra
rows.observation: Turn3 reaction has a wide triangular background slit behind the lowered head, separating raised neck feathers; idle closes.

rows.name: Eagle
rows.observation: Turn3 reaction has an opened nape/shoulder junction with pointed raised neck feather strips behind bowed head. Idle closes; old detached-strip repair is insufficient.

rows.name: Owl
rows.observation: Turn3 reaction and both idle frames split head and rear crown with a large triangular background wedge; rear tuft remains raised on neck.

rows.name: Swift
rows.observation: Turn3 reaction opens a triangular background wedge between head and shoulder; idle closes. Folded wing tips and tiny feet remain intact.

rows.name: Egret
rows.observation: Original baseline fit has detached white crown and back plume pieces floating in turn3 reaction and idle frames, plus a horizontal source-body seam. Island-only repaired variant remains static RED; try measured source joins on that changed variant.
